requirement.evidence: A housing provider shall not make any oral or written inquiry regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to making a conditional offer.
requirement.note: Exceptions (meth production on federally assisted housing, lifetime sex offender registration) and the right to provide evidence are in section 4a(1) and (3).
